evidence.summary: 在 DSH 中共享 SSH 主机配置与连接，提供终端、命令、文件传输、隧道和集群工具。
limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 packages/dsh-ssh/README.md、packages/dsh-ssh/package.json、packages/dsh-ssh/src/client/api.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/client/index.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/client/panel/TerminalTab.tsx、packages/dsh-ssh/src/client/panel/controller.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/client/telemetry.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/cluster.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/connection-pool.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/proxy-command.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/pty.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/sftp.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/terminal-sessions.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/engine/tunnel.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/index.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/loopback.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/routes.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/store.ts、packages/dsh-ssh/src/tools.ts；[Q02](#research-q02) GUI/工具共享pool到真实client.exec与结果；[Q03](#research-q03) loopback/凭据及jump/proxy；[Q04](#research-q04) 实际SFTP、独立Host PTY、tunnel与筛选cluster，各自不同取消/清理边界。
limitations: 完整复核前稿六题/12findings；当前子包版本、Host/client挂载、GUI/工具命令执行、loopback/配置/凭据/多跳与代理关键路径、SFTP本机/远端副作用、PTY attach/关闭回执、tunnel/cluster及心跳。未全审ssh_config解析、全部UI/所有平台/Host或ssh2内部与服务端心跳。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: [Q01](#research-q01) 熟悉SSH的用户在DSH内人工核目标、只读排障与受控传输；成功是预期身份和远端状态，不是connected或发送完成。
[Q02](#research-q02) GUI/工具共享pool到真实client.exec与结果；[Q03](#research-q03) loopback/凭据及jump/proxy；[Q04](#research-q04) 实际SFTP、独立Host PTY、tunnel与筛选cluster，各自不同取消/清理边界。
完整复核前稿六题/12findings；当前子包版本、Host/client挂载、GUI/工具命令执行、loopback/配置/凭据/多跳与代理关键路径、SFTP本机/远端副作用、PTY attach/关闭回执、tunnel/cluster及心跳。未全审ssh_config解析、全部UI/所有平台/Host或ssh2内部与服务端心跳。
子包0.4.15/Apache-2.0，Node>=24.9.0及DSH>=0.2.2-rc.1，Host/web双入口；npm/聚合发行声明不等于已安装验收。

| 阶段 | 现金与资源 | 人工与时间 |
|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 测试机/网络/存储价格未知 | 身份/版本/权限配置分钟未知 |
| 持续 | 远端CPU/带宽/磁盘、连接/缓冲，可选模型费未知 | 核目标/输出及密钥管理未知 |
| 失败恢复 | 重放/部分文件/连接残留资源未知 | 独立对账/恢复分钟未知，无续传承诺 |
| 退出 | 已耗远端/模型资源不可假定退款 | 核进程/端口/文件/配置备份，未测 |
[Q05](#research-q05) 固定Host/Node与独立home，临时低权限key先人工只读并独立核公钥；停用forwardAgent/ProxyCommand及批量/模型入口直到另有明确授权。断线/关闭未知先对账，退出逐项核进程、端口和文件，不依赖删tab或删host。

| 目标 | 当前支持 | 未证结果 |
|---|---|---|
| DSH集成 | 共用engine/配置和工具 | 相对OpenSSH净节时 |
| 控制取消 | channel KILL/close及局部cancel结果 | 远端停止/撤销与绝不重放 |
| 文件传输 | 实际SFTP和finally清channel | 原子文件、hash正确、断点恢复 |
| 终端关闭 | 明确close帧/失败保留tab | send成功非Host/远端完成ACK |
| 多机/隧道 | selector/并发/loopback | 服务可用/批量原子与生产隔离 |
[Q02](#research-q02)共享acquire/inFlight与有条件重试；[Q04](#research-q04)SFTP finally、Host PTY重附着、共享tunnel生命周期有局部价值。pool signal接线、关闭发送与回执、不同资源撤销边界必须分别核；不以测试规模等同安全验收。
[Q02](#research-q02)和[Q04](#research-q04)确认GUI与六工具共享真实引擎、按alias共享acquire、inFlight避免扫活动连接、可detach/attach的Host PTY以及共享tunnel最后释放，形成可解释组合；SSH协议/认证/OS权限继承ssh2与部署，不以功能数量或测试文件证明运维效果。
[Q03](#research-q03) 本机门/alias不等于身份pin和每次批准，明文配置和本机路径处于Host权限；[Q02](#research-q02)断线可能重放且关闭channel不撤副作用；[Q04](#research-q04)发送close即true使删tab不是远端停止验收，停用/删host也不能直接推所有资源撤销。
[Q06](#research-q06)冻结公钥/配置版本/批准/可查询作业ID，断线和取消后先unknown对账，并把发送与Host处理回执分开；对照known_hosts+日志及最小修补，在可丢弃机核误目标/重复写/恢复分钟，等价可替代或确认成本更高就推翻。未实现未验。

| 依赖或条件 | 具体要求 | 缺失/边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 本插件 | @linxin666/dsh-ssh 0.4.15，Apache-2.0 | 安装产物未验 |
| Node/Host | Node>=24.9.0，DSH>=0.2.2-rc.1 | 正确profile/client，不能沿用旧版本声明 |
| 运行库 | ssh2^1.17.0、ws^8.18.0、xterm^6.0.0，React/DOM^18.2.0 | 库契约/实际握手未验 |
| SSH服务器/网络 | 受限账号、可独立核公钥 | 插件层没hostVerifier/known_hosts |
| Host OS权限 | 本地文件/agent/proxy shell | 非bash沙箱，forwardAgent另明确信任 |
| 模型/工具权限 | 仅Agent工具需要 | GUI只读无需模型轮次，公告不等于审批 |

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)/[Q04](#research-q04)：novelty9为成熟SSH/PTY/SFTP与DSH工具组合接缝，超过无适配0；不是新协议/身份或事务方法到18。mechanism15有acquire复用、inFlight、独立PTY/reattach及共享tunnel清理的局部取舍，超过薄封装8；身份pin、作业对账与关闭ACK未解决，直接替代OpenSSH/known_hosts/脚本的关键可靠性限制仍在，不到23。transferability10的detach/attach及共享record生命周期可用于其他远端控制台，超本页面私有5；ssh2/Host服务强绑定，未验跨Host或主要反例Windows子进程、断线重放，不到15。simplification8共享一engine、一次acquire与成熟ssh2减少GUI/工具重复连接层，超入口4；PTY/传输/代理/隧道仍多生命周期和恢复责任，未到11。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)/[Q05](#research-q05)：workflow0，GUI与工具同配置和多机并行仍是同用户发命令/核结果，未形成组织分工/审批交接变化到9，不能按集中入口加分。delivery0，命令文本/远端文件/端口与成熟SSH/SFTP交付同类，没有新验收对象或服务交付到8。reach0，仍需SSH配置/权限和目标核查技能，未识别此前被排除明确人群到5。economics0，远端资源、凭据、恢复责任及可选模型仍由同用户提供；未识别供给/计价/资源组织或服务风险结构变化到4，净费用未知另外列缺口，不以未测ROI当归零理由。

recommendation.reason: 熟悉 SSH 且能核主机身份的开发者，可在匹配版本、独立 home 和低权限隔离测试机先试人工审核的只读命令。它把 DSH 的 GUI 与模型工具接到共享配置和连接，并保留可重新附着的终端，比手动切换多一些接线，但没有逐次批准、身份 pin 或远端结果对账保证。身份、断线或关闭后状态不明就停用相关操作并回 OpenSSH/SFTP 独立核进程、文件与连接，要求生产隔离或确定撤销时先观察。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)明确DSH内多机排障/传输且[Q02](#research-q02)真实命令/输出支持重复任务，超过一般用途15；缺真实用户需求频次与对照，不到30。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)共享池/工具与[Q04](#research-q04)Host PTY重附着相对单独SSH窗口有具体接缝，超过纯UI便利6；[Q03](#research-q03)身份pin与[Q04](#research-q04)回执缺口，未证比成熟替代更可靠或节时到19。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)工具/路由→engine→client.exec/输出失败、[Q03](#research-q03)配置和权限、[Q04](#research-q04)文件/PTY/隧道/cluster真实副作用与失败已核，超过片段6；无运行握手/远端/Host效果，不到19。

cost.rationale: [Q05](#research-q05)隔离home/低权限机/只读及成熟SSH退路可局部控制，超过无路可退0；[Q02](#research-q02)重放、[Q04](#research-q04)部分文件和不确定关闭、[Q03](#research-q03)凭据撤销仍需人工且费用/恢复未量化，不到10。

publication.summaries.text: 在 DSH 中共享 SSH 主机配置与连接，提供终端、命令、文件传输、隧道和集群工具。

items.界面: 主机配置、独立PTY终端、传输、隧道和集群页面。
items.模型工具: 六工具共享连接引擎，实际执行远端命令/文件/网络操作。
items.后台: 池化连接、Host terminal registry及本机loopback路由；权限非文件沙箱。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 实际接线 | 使用边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 主机配置 | GUI CRUD/导入，工具只读摘要 | 明文密码口令；alias非身份pin |
| 命令 | client.exec，stdout/stderr/exit | 断线可重放；取消不回滚 |
| 终端 | 独立PTY与Host session attach | detach保留；send关闭非完成ACK |
| 文件 | fastPut/Get及GUI staging | Host任意本机路径权限，失败可部分文件 |
| 隧道/集群 | loopback listener/forwardOut；selector并发 | forwarding非服务成功，逐host非事务 |

# dsh-ssh > 在 DSH 中共享 SSH 主机配置与连接，提供终端、命令、文件传输、隧道和集群工具。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[zhu1090093659/dsh-web](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web) - **版本号**：0.4.15（[固定提交 1f148567c2f2c2a7ee84b8cef2d3c5fa959d2f1a](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/tree/1f148567c2f2c2a7ee84b8cef2d3c5fa959d2f1a)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-06（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源码支持DSH SSH集成与关键副作用链；仅建议熟悉SSH者在低权限隔离机人工审核只读试用，不能作为身份pin、沙箱或关闭完成保证；未运行目标/账号/远端。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：[Q01](#research-q01) 熟悉SSH的用户在DSH内人工核目标、只读排障与受控传输；成功是预期身份和远端状态，不是connected或发送完成。 - **亮点**：[Q02](#research-q02)和[Q04](#research-q04)确认GUI与六工具共享真实引擎、按alias共享acquire、inFlight避免扫活动连接、可detach/attach的Host PTY以及共享tunnel最后释放，形成可解释组合；SSH协议/认证/OS权限继承ssh2与部署，不以功能数量或测试文件证明运维效果。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 本机门/alias不等于身份pin和每次批准，明文配置和本机路径处于Host权限；[Q02](#research-q02)断线可能重放且关闭channel不撤副作用；[Q04](#research-q04)发送close即true使删tab不是远端停止验收，停用/删host也不能直接推所有资源撤销。 - **建议**：[Q06](#research-q06)冻结公钥/配置版本/批准/可查询作业ID，断线和取消后先unknown对账，并把发送与Host处理回执分开；对照known_hosts+日志及最小修补，在可丢弃机核误目标/重复写/恢复分钟，等价可替代或确认成本更高就推翻。未实现未验。 采用建议：[Q05](#research-q05) 固定Host/Node与独立home，临时低权限key先人工只读并独立核公钥；停用forwardAgent/ProxyCommand及批量/模型入口直到另有明确授权。断线/关闭未知先对账，退出逐项核进程、端口和文件，不依赖删tab或删host。 ## 核心贡献 [Q02](#research-q02)和[Q04](#research-q04)确认GUI与六工具共享真实引擎、按alias共享acquire、inFlight避免扫活动连接、可detach/attach的Host PTY以及共享tunnel最后释放，形成可解释组合；SSH协议/认证/OS权限继承ssh2与部署，不以功能数量或测试文件证明运维效果。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 本机门/alias不等于身份pin和每次批准，明文配置和本机路径处于Host权限；[Q02](#research-q02)断线可能重放且关闭channel不撤副作用；[Q04](#research-q04)发送close即true使删tab不是远端停止验收，停用/删host也不能直接推所有资源撤销。 ## #### 缺口 - 缺同任务OpenSSH对照、发行包与Host安装验收。 **影响**：不能由集成清单推需求强度、净节时或完整兼容。 **进一步探讨**：低权限隔离环境先比较相同只读排障任务与目标核对成本。 ### Q02 · 命令如何实际执行，取消、重试和输出证明什么？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 ssh_exec execute直接await engine.exec(alias,command,timeout,exec.signal)，失败转success:false及error；GUI POST /exec通过loopback guard后同样调用engine.exec但不传signal。引擎转execCommand，按alias取池或acquire共享一次在途连接；store不存在alias即报错。记录以alias为键，连接坏才重建；单次调用inFlight防空闲回收，但不等于远端命令互斥或作业去重。 execCommand真实client.exec(command)。默认命令预算60秒是连接ready后的channel预算，连接/认证另30秒可配置；默认stdout/stderr各按2MiB截断。exitCode=0才success，非零仍返回结果；close无数值exit且非timeout会拒绝，只有record.broken时withClient才最多三次总尝试，健康连接逻辑错误不重放。断线发生在远端已写之后仍可能重放，三次是总attempts不是初次后再三次；没有远端job ID、幂等键或对账。 Abort signal会监听并尝试stream.signal KILL、close；abort在exec回调前到达也待channel出现再kill。已有close/error且aborted时返回cancelled避免重放，是局部保护；withClient调用末尾仍没传它的第五参数signal，连接错误拒绝与broken竞态仍不能借池的signal判断宣称取消绝不重试。已aborted也没有在acquire前拒绝，连接/认证未受同一signal中止；abort只kill而没有立即finish，若peer不close/error还等预算timer。timeout会硬settle，不等peer ACK，且不能撤销远端子进程/已写副作用。 输出是远端原文，不做秘密脱敏；工具render把stdout/stderr/error带入对话，截断不是数据泄漏防护。命令成功只说明该通道退出码，不等于业务目标正确或远端进程全部停止。所有结论为静态条件核查，未连接服务器或复现竞态。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-ssh/src/tools.ts:66-76](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/blob/1f148567c2f2c2a7ee84b8cef2d3c5fa959d2f1a/packages/dsh-ssh/src/tools.ts#L66-L76) render原样拼stdout/stderr/error。

      "path": "packages/dsh-ssh/README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-ssh · Web SSH Terminal, SFTP Transfer & Remote Operations for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)\n\nEnglish | [中文](README.zh.md)\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@linxin666/dsh-ssh?style=flat-square\" alt=\"Version\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.2--rc.1-4c6ef5?style=flat-square&labelColor=454a54\" alt=\"DSH\">\n   \n  <img src=\"https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square\" alt=\"License\">\n</p>\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <strong>Remote Linux Server Operations & Web SSH Suite for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)</strong><br>\n  <em>xterm.js Web Terminal · Visual SFTP Transfer · Port Forwarding Tunnels · Cluster Execution · 6 Agent Tools</em>\n</p>\n\nA dedicated remote Linux server operations and cluster management plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI and official desktop client: in-process persistent connection pool, Web GUI host inventory management, xterm.js terminal, visual SFTP file transfer, port forwarding tunnels, and 6 dedicated agent tools implemented on top of official NPM SDKs without modifying DSH core source code.\n\n## Capabilities\n\n| Capability | Description |\n| --- | --- |\n| Host management | CRUD, search, connection test; collapsible grouping by environment / tags with per-group batch test; config stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json`; supports key / password / ssh-agent auth (OpenSSH agent, with Pageant still selectable on Windows), passphrase keys, ProxyJump jump hosts (multi-level) and OpenSSH `ProxyCommand` transports (bastion clients) |\n| Config import | One-click parse of a standard `~/.ssh/config` (Host/HostName/User/Port/IdentityFile/IdentityAgent/ForwardAgent/ProxyJump/ProxyCommand, `Include` files, blocks without HostName); `ForwardAgent yes|true|on` imports as enabled and `no|false|off` (or no directive) as disabled; skipped blocks are listed with their reason (wildcard pattern, existing alias, Match block, invalid fields) |\n| Persistent connection pool | Reuses a long-lived connection per host (opposite of the ssh-skill daemon), automatically disconnects after 30 minutes idle, auto-reconnects on disconnect (up to 3 times) |\n| Agent forwarding | Opt-in per host through the `forwardAgent` flag (`ssh -A`); the form has an \"Enable agent forwarding\" checkbox, the host list shows an agent-forwarding badge for enabled hosts, and `ssh_list` reports `forwardAgent` with a forward column in its table. The endpoint is the host's configured agent path, otherwise `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, otherwise the native OpenSSH named pipe (`\\\\.\\pipe\\openssh-ssh-agent`) on Windows; a host with no local endpoint fails with an explicit error instead of connecting without forwarding. A server that refuses the request (`AllowAgentForwarding no`) surfaces its own error and is never downgraded to a silent non-forwarded session. The flag never touches the stored profile when it is off |\n| Command execution | exec with a timeout (default 60s), stdout/stderr separated, output truncation guard (2MB) |\n| Web terminal | xterm.js + WebSocket PTY terminal, auto-sizing, real-time output; the panel holds several terminal tabs, each with its own host PTY — switch, close one at a time, run several tabs against the same host, and the \"+\" control opens another tab on the host the toolbar shows |\n| File transfer | SFTP upload (browser file picker, NDJSON progress stream), download (progress bar + browser save); remote directory browsing |\n| Port forwarding | Local port-forward tunnel (listens on 127.0.0.1 only) to reach a remote database / intranet service; list / stop supported |\n| Cluster execution | One command run concurrently across many hosts (filter by alias / environment / tag, default concurrency 8) |\n| Agent tools | `ssh_list` / `ssh_exec` / `ssh_upload` / `ssh_download` / `ssh_tunnel` / `ssh_cluster`; GUI and Agent share the same host config |\n\nThe panel loads its contents on first open. Closing and reopening it preserves the selected tab, form drafts and every terminal tab. A terminal tab that is not on screen keeps its remote shell in the Host: the view detaches, and returning to the tab reattaches by session id and replays the host's scrollback into the single xterm. A remote shell that exits keeps its tab and its last screen instead of vanishing, and a tab closed in the background is only removed once the Host confirms the close — a close that cannot be delivered keeps the tab and says so. The tunnel list refreshes every five seconds while its tab, panel and browser page are visible; automatic reads pause when hidden, resume immediately on return, and do not overlap slow reads. Port forwarding itself continues in the Host.\n\n## Security model\n\n- All `/api/dsh-ssh/*` routes are loopback-only (with same-origin checks) — the interfaces that execute commands against remote servers are not exposed to the LAN.\n- Passwords / key passphrases are stored in plain text in `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json`, file mode 0600, directory 0700 (the same trust model as ssh-skill writing passwords into ssh-config comments).\n- ssh-agent auth stores only the agent socket path (or the special value `pageant`); it never reads or stores private-key material. An empty agent path is not a secret and is always saved: it means auto-detect (`SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, then the native OpenSSH named pipe on Windows), so switching a host to SSH Agent takes effect even with the field left blank.\n- Agent forwarding is opt-in per host and off by default. With `forwardAgent` enabled, every exec and PTY session on that host asks the server for `auth-agent-req@openssh.com`, which means the remote host can authenticate as this machine with your local keys. Enable it only for hosts you trust, and remember every session on such a host can use the forwarded agent. When no agent endpoint resolves (the configured agent path, `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, the native OpenSSH named pipe on Windows) the connection fails instead of forwarding nothing, and a server that refuses the request surfaces its error exactly as it comes back.\n- Tunnels only listen on `127.0.0.1`.\n- Deleting a host or changing its connection fields (host / port / user / auth / proxyJump / proxyCommand / forwardAgent) immediately closes that alias's pooled connection and tunnels; later operations reconnect with the new configuration and never reuse a connection authenticated with the old credentials.\n- When the SSH connection behind a tunnel drops, the tunnel retires itself: the local port stops accepting, the tunnel leaves the list, and the connection that arrives during the drop is closed without traffic instead of interrupting the host process.\n- A `proxyCommand` value is a shell command executed by the DSH host process with its privileges — exactly the trust `ssh(1)` gives the same line in `~/.ssh/config`. It can only come from the user's own 0600 store file: the Agent cannot create or edit hosts, and `ssh_list` reports only whether a host has one, never the command text.\n- Before the Agent uses a tool, the host must first be configured in the GUI (or imported from ~/.ssh/config).\n- `ssh_upload` / `ssh_download` read/write arbitrary local paths on this machine with host-process privileges (not through the bash sandbox) — same host-local-path semantics as ssh-skill, be aware of that permission surface.\n- Agent transfer tools move files only between this machine and a remote SSH host; local-file reads and writes must use the local file tools (read / write / edit / bash), never the `ssh_*` tools.\n- The remote output of exec / cluster is returned verbatim (not sanitized); a command like `env` may bring secrets from the remote environment back into the conversation log.\n\n## Install\n\nInstall the family aggregate package `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` (all plugins and skins in one) or this plugin alone:\n\n```sh\n### From npm (recommended)\ndsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-ssh@latest\n\n### From the repository (development)\ngit clone https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web.git\ncd dsh-web\npnpm install && pnpm -r build\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)/packages/dsh-ssh\n\n```\n\nAfter installing, **restart `dsh web`**: a \"SSH\" entry appears in the sidebar; the plugin description is injected into the Agent prompt automatically.\n\n## Configuration\n\nThe settings panel (plugin config) toggles `announceToAgent` (whether to announce the plugin to the Agent; off by default so system prompts stay clean) and `enabled` (master switch), sets `terminalFontFamily` (the web terminal font; empty defers to the CSS chain: `--dsh-ssh-terminal-font` → the official `--ds-font-family-code` token → the built-in monospace stack), and sets `connectTimeoutMs` (the shared ceiling for TCP connect, SSH key exchange and user authentication, default 30000 ms, allowed 1000-600000). Raise `connectTimeoutMs` on hosts whose authentication is slow (for example PAM or LDAP behind a distant directory service): every connection entry point — `ssh_exec`, the web terminal, SFTP transfers, tunnels and cluster runs — reads it, while the `timeoutMs` argument of `ssh_exec` / `ssh_cluster` only bounds the remote command once the connection is ready. The terminal font is fixed in the xterm constructor, so a plain stylesheet cannot override it; to render powerline / Nerd Font glyphs, enter a Nerd Font stack here (e.g. `\"SauceCodePro Nerd Font\", monospace`). Changes re-apply to open terminals live, no reconnect needed; a new `connectTimeoutMs` applies to connections opened afterwards, and pooled connections are unaffected until they reconnect.\n\n## Data\n\n- Host config: `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` (versioned JSON, atomic write)\n- Transfer staging: `os.tmpdir()/dsh-ssh-uploads/` (0700 directory, 0600 in-flight files)\n\n## Development\n\n```sh\npnpm install --filter @linxin666/dsh-ssh...\npnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-ssh test    # unit tests: store + engine (embedded ssh2 Server + real sshd)\npnpm --filter @linxin666/dsh-ssh build   # tsc types + tsdown dual-half artifacts\n```\n\n## Known limitations\n\n- The remote target path of an upload must be an absolute path (relative paths are rejected).\n- Download does not support a whole directory yet (download files individually); upload supports recursive directories (walks the local directory and transfers file by file).\n- exec auto-reconnect on disconnect (up to 3 times) may re-execute non-idempotent commands — watch out for side effects on long commands.\n- A ProxyJump hop is either a host alias configured in this plugin or an OpenSSH `[user@]host[:port]` address; an address hop has no stored credentials, so it reuses the target host's authentication (configure a host entry when the hop needs its own).\n- `proxyCommand` and `proxyJump` cannot be combined on one host (OpenSSH resolves them by \"whichever appears first in the config\"; a stored entry has no order, so the plugin rejects the pair), and only the first hop of a chain may declare a ProxyCommand.\n- A ProxyCommand is executed through the user's shell, so it inherits the DSH process's `PATH` and environment. On Windows the shell is killed without its process group, so a client it spawned may outlive the transport.\n- The ssh_config import expands `Include` (globs, `~`, several pathnames, relative to the config directory) but not environment variables or `%` tokens, and a multi-pattern `Host a b` line still imports only its first pattern.\n- Resume (broken-transfer continuation) is not implemented yet.\n- The transfer of Agent tools is a host-machine local path (same semantics as ssh-skill).\n\n## Telemetry\n\nThe browser half sends one anonymous install heartbeat per UTC day to dsh-market.com: a random localStorage id plus this package's name, nothing else. The server stores only a salted hash of that id, never IP addresses, and exposes aggregate counts only. See [docs/telemetry.md](../../docs/telemetry.md) for the full contract.\n"

README](packages/dsh-task-board/README.zh.md)）。任务看板不仅仅是一个可视化卡片界面，更是 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Web GUI 与桌面客户端中的**宿主权威后台长程执行与多 Agent 自动化调度引擎**。任务按“待规划、待办、进行中、已完成、已失败”五列进行全生命周期管理，支持项目分区、粘贴文本 AI 解析与卡片多模态附件（每卡最多 8 个图片或文件附件，经官方附件存储 SHA256 核验，执行时图片作为多模态部件入队、文件以只读路径注入），以 Schema v7 事务账本为权威持久化核心，真正实现了长程任务从拆解、父卡自治派发、对抗质检到外部成果闭环的全流程自动化：\n\n- **宿主权威后台驱动与 7x24 小时离线无人值守**：区别于传统仅在前端网页轮询的脆弱看板，所有卡片流转、调度触发与执行监控完全由 DSH 后端 Host 进程作为唯一权威驱动。支持循环 5 字段 Cron 表达式（绑定 IANA 时区与可选 `maxRuns` 次数预算）与单次未来时刻（`once`）两类定时计划；浏览器仅为异步视图，关闭网页标签页、熄灭屏幕或断开网络，后台智能体会话照常并发执行与原子落盘结算。内置跨平台防休眠电源管理（macOS `caffeinate`、Windows `ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED`、带有 systemd-logind 的 Linux `systemd-inhibit`），允许显示器正常关闭的同时阻止整机因闲置休眠，确保夜间无人值守巡检与流水线准时打卡。\n- **树状子任务与父卡自治派发（Subtask Trees & Autonomous Parent Dispatch）**：复杂工程目标可拆解为 1 至 3 层树状子任务（内置环路与深度护栏）。执行任意卡片只为该卡片自身开启**唯一一个**会话，Host 绝不为子任务批量派生独立会话；当执行的卡片存在未完成后代时，Host 自动在本次运行中强制切入 `liangshen`（梁神模式）调度者预设，并在启动 Prompt 中注入未完成子卡清单，由父会话通过 `task_board_get` 逐张读取子卡详情、按依赖顺序通过 `subagent` 自治派发（互不依赖的子任务并发执行），完工前调用 `task_board_manage({ action: 'record-external-outcome' })` 一次性回填各子卡结论（未显式回填的后代由 Host 在父卡终结时幂等兜底结算）。多张独立卡片在同一时刻触发时，由受控准入队列（`runLaunchWidth`，1 至 16，默认 3）治理并发创建会话的宽度。\n- **对抗式双盲质量验收门禁（No False Completion）**：彻底终结 AI 编程中“自述已完成、实则未改动或改崩溃”的虚假交付顽疾。以 goal 形式执行的任务在 Agent 试图调用 `update_goal(complete)` 宣告完工的瞬间被 Host 强制拦截，必须由独立的裁判模型（可自选模型与思考档位）进行真实验收。验收机制沿用严苛的 Coding 质量判据、0.65 绝对通过阈值，每项判据双轮交换 A/B 位置打分消偏，并严格结合会话执行轨迹与宿主工作区真实磁盘文件的 Diff 行级变更审查。首轮未达标精准下发具象结构化问题引导 Agent 自我修复，两次仍不通过才判负，杜绝敷衍糊弄。\n- **GitHub Issues、云端团队协作与手机远端三路扩展**：通过标准外部提供方契约无缝挂载三大官方扩展：[dsh-client-ui-task-board-github](packages/dsh-task-board-github/README.zh.md) 实现任务看板与 GitHub Issues / PR 状态的双向实时同步，远端 Issue 自动入列驱动 Agent 定位修复、运行测试、创建关联 PR 并在合并后自动关单；[dsh-client-ui-task-board-team](packages/dsh-task-board-team/README.zh.md) 将本地 `dsh-agents` 成员绑定至云端 `team-hub`，按租约领取指派 Issue 为本地镜像卡执行，支持决策问题上报、双向评论（`team_comment`）与审阅打回返工；[dsh-task-board-remote](packages/dsh-task-board-remote/README.zh.md) 将看板能力面（`board.v1`）挂载至远程桥扩展缝，让已配对手机直接读写同一份宿主权威账本。\n- **长程目标驱动、会话持久化与冻结交接包（Freeze Handover）**：任务支持武装内置 `/goal` 引擎进行多轮自主续跑；周期性任务可开启会话复用，保留完整上下文记忆；支持通过 `<<<FREEZE` 协议将会话上下文一键冻结为包含“目标/进度/下一步”的结构化快照，并绑定工作区、预设与权限三元组，接手 Agent 瞬间无缝继承前序成果，同时内置提示词注入防御与来源审计。\n- **企业级权限基线、安全确认门与消费熔断保护**：任务可细粒度钉住工作区、Agent 预设、沙箱权限、执行模型与推理思考强度，钉子校验失败即 Fail-Closed；超出安全基线的高权限操作设有「人工确认门（Permission Gate）」，未在 Web 界面显式放行前坚决拒绝执行与调度，杜绝 Agent 越权危害宿主系统；支持配置看板级每日 Token 运行时与高效调度引擎）\n\n在新建会话输入框左侧通过专属老虎机拨杆切换，或在“设置 > Agent 预设”中选用。梁神模式（`dsh-liangshen`）是专为追求**极致推理效率、超低静态上下文开销与严苛工程执行纪律**而深度重构的杀手级预设与运行时插件。针对主流大模型在长程编程任务中容易出现的系统提示词冗长膨胀、工具 Schema 挤占上下文、思维链无效空转（如“流水账推理”）以及多轮遗忘退化等痛点，梁神模式通过原生极简提示词、程序化代码工具调用（PTC）、MCP 温和分页与关键事实局部就近投射，提供纯粹而强悍的编程作战体验：\n\n- **极简 Persona 与严苛行动导向纪律（Zero Prompt Waste）**：彻底剥离官方 Standard 预设中冗长繁琐的系统级条文，将提示词极致收敛为单行 Persona 与经过实战千锤百炼的高效工程纪律。内置反思熔断（同一假设推演不超过两轮，缺少事实立即闭合思考并调用原生工具探测，杜绝凭空揣测）、行动导向（思考过程仅用于决定下一步具体操作，严禁在思考中预演完整代码）、并发探索（单轮内并发派发多个独立检测或搜索工具）、YAGNI 与 PDCA 循环（单步验证单一假设，不写冗余注水注释）、以及有界收敛纪律（前置检查最多 2-3 轮即刻收敛，迅速转入实际作答或编辑）。大幅降低静态 Token 占用，让模型注意力百分之百倾注于业务与代码本身。\n- **程序化工具调用传输（PTC · Programmatic Tool Calling）**：彻底终结在每次请求中平铺上百个 JSON Schema 工具参数的低效模式。默认将网络线协议（wire）极致收拢为唯一的 `run_code`（运行 TypeScript 脚本），其余所有工具均通过自动生成的强类型 SDK 在独立的沙箱线程中以代码形式调用。无论系统注册了多少复杂工具，静态传输面始终保持极小体积；模型可原生利用 `Promise.all` 编写并发工具调用，并在程序内预先过滤、聚合、提取关键数据，只将精炼结论回传至对话上下文，从根本上解决大文本输出打爆 Token 的问题。对于习惯原生工具面的场景，亦可在插件设置中一键无缝切换为组装好的原生工具清单（Native）。\n- **MCP 工具温和分页与 LRU 动态激活（Gentle Tool Paging）**：针对海量 MCP 工具或第三方插件扩展，出厂默认启用温和分页（默认匹配 `mcp__*`）。外部工具在初始状态下仅以命名空间摘要形式登记在目录消息中，既不占 wire 协议也不进 SDK 声明；当大模型判定需要使用对应工具时，可自主调用 `tool_activate({ namespace })` 按需挂载。内置 LRU 策略（上限 3 个活跃命名空间），自动淘汰最久未用的命名空间，激活状态在会话压缩与恢复后完整重建，兼具海量工具接入能力与极致小巧的静态 Schema 面。\n- **关键事实登记簿与就近状态投射（Fact Register & Working Context）**：长程多轮对话中大模型极易遗忘早期的关键业务约束或踩过的坑。插件向模型提供专属 `fact_register` 工具，可将用户硬性约束、已确认的架构决策或失败路径登记为单行事实（每条不超过 160 字符，最多保留 12 条）。关键事实随 `[Working Context: ...]` 状态行在每一轮交互中就近投射至最新消息尾部的局部注意力窗口内，从物理机制上彻底解决长上下文“中间遗忘”与重复踩坑顽疾。\n- **原生调度者架构与敏捷访谈纪律（Dispatcher Identity & Triage）**：预设出厂深度集成调度者（Dispatcher）架构规范，赋能模型以团队指挥官身份统领工程任务。内置复杂度分诊机制（L0/L1 单点任务直接敏捷执行，L2 复杂任务严格遵循“澄清访谈 -> 架构规划 -> 并发子代理派发 -> 双层严格验收”标准流）；设定严格的提问预算控制（单轮最多 4 问、总计最多 3 轮、影响面排序、假设先行），杜绝无效拉扯；任务状态权威沉淀于 `todo_write`，杜绝浮躁的敷衍式交付。\n- **新建会话老虎机拨杆与炫酷中奖特效（Composer Slot Lever）**：在新建会话输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧，精心打造了一台复古老虎机拨杆控件。下拉拨杆（支持鼠标拖拽、单击或键盘快捷操作）即可一键为当前新建会话装配梁神模式，拉下命中即触发绚丽的中奖粒子特效（闪光、冲击环、火花粒子与专属彩蛋横幅）；上推即可平滑切回默认模式。拨杆自适应全局主题色彩，且在会话开始后自动隐藏，丝滑灵动，极具极客趣味。\n\n详细机制、评测数据与高级配置参数见 [dsh-liangshen README](packages/dsh-liangshen/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 智能体小队（Agent Squads · 可复用成员定义与整队协同运行）\n\n通过侧边栏“智能体”入口进入。智能体小队（`dsh-agents`）把跨会话复用的专业 AI 角色与团队编制沉淀为宿主权威账本：每个小队管理一组有序成员，既可按需单独点播某个成员开启专属会话，也可一键发起整队 Agent Teams 协同攻坚：\n\n- **可复用小队与成员定义（Reusable Squad & Member Definitions）**：小队支持配置名称、职责描述、可选绑定工作区与整队运行的 Lead 预设；每位成员独立钉住显示名称、Agent 预设（如梁神模式或研究小队预设）、沙箱权限、模型路由、推理思考强度与成员简报（Brief）。成员简报仅通过系统提示词段注入该成员专属会话，绝不污染首条用户消息或普通对话会话。\n- **整队 Agent Teams 协同运行与实时投影（Whole-Squad Runs & Live Projection）**：一键启动整队运行，小队名册与任务目标经 `team:squad` 系统提示词上下文直达 `<小队名> / Lead` 会话；Lead 按成员钉住的预设、权限与模型动态孵化专属 Teammate，任一钉子无法兑现立即 Fail-Closed 报错而不静默降级。前端直接读取共享会话存储中的 `agentTeam` 投影（`stateVersion` 4），实时呈现 Lead 与各 Teammate 的角色、执行阶段与启动异常，全程无需轮询。\n- **10 项全会话定义管理与启动工具（10 Model-Facing Management & Launch Tools）**：向宿主全体会话注册 `squads_list`、`squads_read`、`squads_create`、`squads_update`、`squads_delete`、`squad_member_add`、`squad_member_update`、`squad_member_remove`、`squads_run_member`、`squads_run_squad` 共 10 项进程内工具，支持对话中的 Agent 自主编排小队、点播单成员会话或发起整队运行，删除操作强制要求 `confirm: true` 安全确认。\n- **原子账本持久化与同源运行时避让（Atomic Ledger & Runtime Coexistence）**：定义与最新 200 条运行记录经临时文件 fsync + 原子 rename 持久化于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-agents/ledger.json`（由 `ledger.json.lock` 保证单进程独占，损坏账本原样保留绝不覆盖）；当宿主已挂载官方 `agentTeams` 服务时自动避让内置团队运行时并无缝复用官方状态投影。\n\n详细契约、工具表与安全模型见 [dsh-agents README](packages/dsh-agents/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 实时浏览器视图（Browser View · 右侧栏 CDP 实时投屏与网页自动化）\n\n在会话右侧栏标签条或引导胶囊中打开。实时浏览器视图（`dsh-browser-view`）为 Agent 提供一个由宿主驱动、用户可在聊天旁侧实时观看的受控 Chromium 浏览器标签页，实现前端开发验证、视觉巡检与网页交互的全程可视化闭环：\n\n- **右侧栏 CDP 实时投屏与保活挂载（Right-Docked Screencast & Keep-Mounted View）**：注册专属右侧栏标签页类型 `browser-view`（与官方 `browser` 标签页和平共处），通过单条 WebSocket 实时绘制 CDP `Page.startScreencast` 画面帧、当前 URL、标题与 Agent 最近一次操作摘要；切换标签 chip 时保持挂载不断连，仅在页面变化时推流。\n- **默认隔离 Chromium 与真实已登录浏览器接管（Isolated Chromium & Real Browser Attach）**：默认惰性拉起带有一次性临时配置目录与随机调试端口的无头 Chromium（固定 1280x800 视口，访问本机 DSH Web GUI 遇 401 鉴权时自动内存取票完成登录）；开启 `realBrowserEnabled` 后可通过本地回环 CDP 端点（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:9222`）直接接管用户以非默认数据目录启动的 Chrome 或 Edge，直接在既有登录态下操作全部标签页，绝不导出或复制任何 Cookie。\n- **11 项受控浏览器交互工具（11 Agent Browser Tools）**：提供 `browser_navigate`、`browser_click`、`browser_type`、`browser_press`、`browser_scroll`、`browser_snapshot`、`browser_screenshot`、`browser_console`、`browser_network`、`browser_tabs`、`browser_close` 完整工具链；`browser_snapshot` 输出深度优先编号（`ref`）与坐标框的 DOM 结构树供精准点击与输入，每个标签页独立维护控制台日志与网络请求环形缓冲区。\n- **高保真无损区域截图与证据入列（Lossless Region Screenshots & Transcript Evidence）**：`browser_screenshot` 默认输出无损 PNG 并经宿主附件服务直接写入对话轨迹；支持传入与 `browser_snapshot` 同坐标系的 `clip: { x, y, width, height }` 进行局部区域裁剪（默认 2x 渲染倍率，可选 1x/2x/3x），显著提升模型视觉 Token 细节分辨率，越界裁剪或连接失败均显式报错而不静默回退。\n\n详细配置、真实浏览器启动参数与安全边界见 [dsh-browser-view README](packages/dsh-browser-view/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 手机 App 远程访问（Mobile Remote · 原生手机 App 接入）\n\n在 profile 中安装 [`@linxin666/dsh-remote-bridge`](packages/dsh-remote-bridge/README.zh.md) 插件并重启服务后，点击侧边栏底部的二维码图标（aria-label 为「配对 iPhone」）打开配对面板。使用手机 App 扫码即可直接开始使用。\n\n配对面板具备本地安全保护，令牌路由（`/remote-bridge/pair/token`）带有回环门控，仅允许在本机浏览器中访问（非本机访问返回 403）。面板生成的配对码为一次性凭据，有效期为 30 秒，点击「重新取码」将作废上一张配对码。二维码编码包含服务地址与令牌的文档（URL 形如 `wss://<origin>/ios/v1?token=...`），手机 App 扫码后即可同时获取服务地址与鉴权令牌。\n\n网络接入协议面仅暴露 `/ios/v1` 一个 WebSocket 端点，隧道与局域网转发均指向仅放行该路径的入站闸门，公网无法直接访问 Web GUI 路由。服务地址按实时状态（中继租约或运行中的隧道）、环境变量 `DSH_REMOTE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 以及局域网转发器实际监听地址的顺序解析。默认配置下公网可用（中继默认开启、隧道默认关闭、局域网转发默认关闭）；若需在局域网内直连，需在插件配置中开启局域网转发。\n\n[iOS App 还在内测，欢迎来 Discord 交流](https://discord.gg/nBy28kjun)。\n\n### 远程连接（SSH Ops · Web 终端、SFTP 传输与集群运维）\n\n通过侧边栏“SSH”入口打开远程运维面板（详见 [dsh-ssh README](packages/dsh-ssh/README.zh.md)）。支持密钥与密码认证，可一键导入本地 `~/.ssh/config` 主机列表；配置数据安全保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 中。面板提供以下操作能力：\n\n- **Web 终端**：基于 xterm.js 的完整远程交互终端，支持实时输出与窗口自适应；\n- **文件传输**：集成 SFTP 上传与下载功能，提供进度提示并支持可视化浏览远程目录；\n- **端口转发**：支持建立本地到远程内部服务的加密隧道（如内网数据库、后端 API），默认仅监听 127.0.0.1 安全地址；\n- **集群并发执行**：支持多主机批量命令执行，并可通过别名、运行环境或标签进行过滤；\n- **Agent 直连调用**：智能体与面板共享主机配置，在会话中发出指令即可委派 Agent 执行远程巡检与运维命令。\n\n### 使用统计（Usage Statistics · Token 消耗追踪、余额预警与 Token 银行）\n\n在“设置 > 使用统计”中集中查看 token 消耗数据、供应商余额以及编程套餐额度，支持自动定时刷新与手动即时查询。\n\n- **用量明细**：查看每日输入、输出与缓存用量，按不同供应商与模型细分展示，并提供最近 30 天消费趋势；支持的供应商提供账户余额查询，针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费与账单估算。\n- **个人套餐追踪**：实时展示 Kimi、GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、Codex / ChatGPT 等平台编程套餐的使用比例与重置周期。\n- **Token 银行**：所有 provider 每消耗 100 万 tokens 铸造 1 鲸元，以“鲸元券”形式展示台账周期内的累计 token 与调用指标，支持保存票券卡片与系统级分享。\n- **桌面宠物联动**：安装宠物插件后，可通过桌面悬浮挂件的气泡提示直接查看当前会话供应商的额度、余额或今日消耗。\n\n统计自插件首次启用起计，不回填历史数据；鲸元券统计台账窗口内所有 provider 的 tokens（消费行仍只来自 DeepSeek 官方余额观测）。支持的供应商列表与配置细节见 [dsh-usage README](packages/dsh-usage/README.zh.md)。\n\n![DeepSeek Token 用量统计与 Token 银行 — API 消耗追踪与账单估算](docs/screenshots/35-usage-token-bank.webp)\n\n### 会话归档管理（Session Archive Manager · 全文检索与生命周期策略）\n\n会话归档管理（`dsh-session-archive`）是专为解决大量长短期会话堆积而设计的集中管理模块，随全家桶安装生效：\n\n- **集中检索与状态筛选**：统一呈现活跃会话、已归档会话、空白会话、子代理派生会话以及无工作区会话，支持按标题、工作区、状态及会话 ID 进行关键词搜索与多维排序；\n- **安全批量操作**：支持跨筛选结果的多选批量归档、批量恢复以及级联物理删除。执行物理删除时系统将明确提示受影响的后代会话数与预计释放空间，大批量删除需二次确认；当前处于运行中或带有运行中子代理的会话受到严格保护，防止误删；\n- **自动化生命周期策略**：提供两个默认关闭的自动化策略：根据最后活跃时间自动归档、根据归档时间自动清理超期数据，支持在启用前进行结果预览与单次手动执行。\n\n删除操作不可逆，所有管理路由严格限制本机回环访问。详细机制见 [dsh-session-archive README](packages/dsh-session-archive/README.zh.md)。\n\n### 安装排障\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>展开查看常见安装与构建排障方案</strong></summary>\n\n<br>\n\n> **pnpm 严格依赖隔离导致模块找不到**：pnpm 的 isolated 模式默认仅将聚合包放置在顶层，部分子包可能被嵌套收敛，导致 `dsh web` 启动时报错 `Cannot find package '@linxin666/dsh-...'`。若遇到此情况，可在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中添加配置 `nodeLinker: hoisted`（或 `public-hoist-pattern: ['@linxin666/*']`）后重新安装。\n\n> **构建脚本被拦截 (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS)**：这三项审批必须在首次 add 之前就位。正确顺序是重置 profile（官方 `--from-default-profile web`）或换新 profile，在 `<profile>/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里把三项写成映射，再执行 add：\n>\n> ```yaml\n> allowBuilds:\n>   cloudflared: true\n>   cpu-features: true\n>   ssh2: true\n> ```\n>\n> 必须写成上面的映射形式：列表形式会被 pnpm 改写成 `'0': cloudflared` 之类的占位条目，重跑时还会回退已解析的包（`Packages: -10`）。装失败后补审批重跑会 exit 0，但 `dsh.profile.bundles` 仍无该行：静默半挂载，重跑修不回来，需要先 remove 再 add。已带审批的存量 profile 升级不受影响。\n\n> **pnpm 11 发布时间门禁问题**：在包版本发布后的短时间内，pnpm 11 的默认安全策略（`minimumReleaseAge`）可能会尝试回退拉取旧版本。建议在 profile 目录的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中排除相关命名空间以确保获取最新版本：\n>\n> ```yaml\n> minimumReleaseAgeExclude:\n>   - '@linxin666/*'\n> ```\n\n</details>\n\n## 兼容性与运行环境\n\ndsh-web 针对主流操作系统、现代化浏览器及网络拓扑进行了深度工程调优与兼容性保障：\n\n| 维度 | 支持范围与技术规格 |\n| --- | --- |\n| 宿主运行环境 | DeepSeek Harness 常见问题\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>安装重启后，侧边栏未显示插件入口？</strong></summary>\n\n请首先检查插件是否正确安装至 `web` profile（命令需包含 `--profile web`），并通过 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 验证配置层是否已成功挂载。注意仅刷新网页无法加载新模块，必须彻底重启 `dsh web` 后端服务进程。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>定时任务为何未能按时触发执行？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，无需保持前端浏览器页面打开。若宿主进程退出、系统关机或整机进入深度睡眠，错过的触发时间点将遵循跳过策略处理，不执行回填补跑；若任务到达触发点时上一轮仍在运行，会自动顺延至下一个周期。若需要允许息屏但防止主机自动睡眠，可开启任务看板自带的电源保护选项。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>手机 App 配对后为何没有收到流式推送？</strong></summary>\n\n手机 App 通过协议 v1 的 WebSocket 通道与宿主通信。隧道或中继中断期间流式更新暂停，网络恢复后连接会自动重连；更新节奏的差异主要来自广域网往返延迟。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>试穿主题皮肤不满意如何还原？</strong></summary>\n\n皮肤面板提供免落盘试穿功能：点击试穿即刻在当前界面生效预览，离开面板或关闭预览会自动恢复初始外观；只有显式点击“应用”按钮才会将主题配置写入磁盘，可放心预览各类主题。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>是否可以仅使用主题皮肤或某个单一插件？</strong></summary>\n\n完全支持。若仅需要视觉定制，直接安装 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center` 即可；若仅需特定功能，参考“单独安装某个插件”章节直接安装对应 npm 包即可。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>已安装全家桶的前提下，能否额外独立安装某个子插件？</strong></summary>\n\n可以。聚合包内部的插件注册标识均统一带有 `web-ui-` 前缀（例如 `web-ui-usage`），与独立包的原生标识（如 `usage`）相互独立，不会产生 loader entry 重复冲突。宿主服务对同类插件会自动去重。通常情况下安装全家桶即可满足完整需求，无需重复安装单个子包。\n\n</details>\n\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何通过手机 App 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness？是否必须在同一 Wi-Fi 下？</strong></summary>\n\n手机远程访问由协议 v1 支撑，不要求必须处于同一 Wi-Fi。默认配置下插件已开启公网中继服务，在电脑端点击侧栏底部的二维码图标打开配对面板后，使用手机 App 扫码即可直接通过公网连接；亦可配置 Cloudflare 隧道。若希望在同一局域网内直连访问，需在插件配置中开启局域网转发并扫码配对。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>关闭浏览器或电脑休眠后，DeepSeek 的定时任务还会继续运行吗？</strong></summary>\n\n任务调度完全由 `dsh web` 后端宿主进程驱动，关闭浏览器标签页不影响定时任务的触发与执行。但如果整机进入深度睡眠或关机，宿主进程将暂停运行，离线期间错过的触发点会遵循跳过策略处理。若希望保持无人值守后台自动化，可在任务看板设置中开启“电源保护”选项，该选项会阻止系统因空闲进入休眠（允许显示器正常熄灭），确保定时任务准时触发。\n\n</details>\n\n<details>\n<summary><strong>如何查看和监控 DeepSeek 及其他模型 API 的 Token 消耗与账户余额？</strong></summary>\n\n安装使用统计插件后，在“设置 > 使用统计”面板中可查看按日汇总的输入、输出与缓存 Token 数量，支持按模型细分查看 30 天消费趋势。针对 DeepSeek 官方路由还提供峰谷分时计费估算；若配置了支持查询余额的供应商 API，插件可定时拉取当前账户剩余额度与重置周期。\n\n</details>\n\n## 已知限制\n\n- 任务看板由后端 Host 进程统一调度，关闭前端标签页不影响任务执行；但若宿主进程停止或操作系统关机睡眠，处于离线期间的触发点将直接跳过不补跑。可选的电源保护仅阻止系统闲置睡眠，无法阻止用户主动合盖、手动休眠或电源切断，技术细节见 [dsh-task-board README](packages/dsh-task-board/README.zh.md)。\n- SSH 凭据（密码与私钥口令）保存在本地 `~/.dsh/dsh-ssh.json` 文件中（文件权限为 0600）；在网络中断重连时可能重新发送非幂等命令，终端输出保持原样返回不执行脱敏，安全规范见 [dsh-ssh README](packages/dsh-ssh/README.zh.md)。\n- 手机 App 流式交互经隧道或中继转发，广域网往返延迟叠加在每次更新上；固定域名中继比裸快速隧道多一跳，两者均可使用。\n- 从源码构建全仓需要 Node.js >= 24.9 与 pnpm 工具链，直接从 npm 安装不受此限制。\n\n## Both are read at submit time, and\n * the window between a tab switch's commit and the effect that rebinds the\n * socket is exactly when they can disagree.\n * @param linkTabId - the tab the bound socket belongs to.\n * @param formTabId - the tab whose challenge form is on screen.\n */\nexport function challengeBelongsToLink(linkTabId: string | undefined, formTabId: string | undefined): boolean {\n  return linkTabId !== undefined && linkTabId === formTabId\n}\n\n/** The terminal view with its tab strip. */\nexport function TerminalTab({ api, controller, presetAlias, terminalFont }: TerminalTabProps) {\n  const { terminalTabs, activeTerminalTabId, draftAlias } = useSyncExternalStore(\n    useCallback(listener => controller.subscribe(listener), [controller]),\n    useCallback(() => controller.getSnapshot(), [controller]),\n  )\n  const [hosts, setHosts] = useState<SshHostSummary[]>([])\n  const [listError, setListError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined)\n  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)\n  const termRef = useRef<Terminal | null>(null)\n  const fitRef = useRef<FitAddon | null>(null)\n  const linkRef = useRef<BoundLink | null>(null)\n  const dataSubRef = useRef<IDisposable | null>(null)\n  /** Tab whose screen the terminal currently holds. */\n  const renderedRef = useRef<string | undefined>(undefined)\n  /** Tabs with a background close in flight, so one click cannot open two. */\n  const closingRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set())\n  const fontSource = terminalFont ?? A window resize is only one\n  // trigger: the status banner appearing after connect, panel resizes, and\n  // sidebar toggles all change the container without a window resize, so the\n  // container itself is observed (otherwise the viewport keeps the pre-banner\n  // height and the last line is clipped below the fold). const link = linkRef.current\n    linkRef.current = null\n    if (link === null) return\n    const connection = link.connection\n    connection.onReady = undefined\n    connection.onOutput = undefined\n    connection.onExit = undefined\n    connection.onAuthPrompt = undefined\n    const tab = controller.terminalTab(link.tabId)\n    if (tab === undefined) {\n      // The tab was closed while this socket was already releasing: nothing can\n      // reattach to it, so the session has to end rather than be detached into\n      // an ownerless PTY.\n      controller.adoptTerminalLink(link.tabId, connection, 'close')\n      return\n    }\n    if (tab.status === 'connecting') {\n      // No session id yet, so a detach frame would end nothing: the host would\n      // keep connecting into a session nobody can attach to. Hand it to the\n      // controller, which detaches (or closes) the moment the id arrives.\n      controller.adoptTerminalLink(link.tabId, connection, 'detach')\n      return\n    }\n    connection.detach()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Whether the single terminal still shows another tab. A terminal that was\n   * just created (or disposed) holds nothing, so it needs no clear; every other\n   * rebind must start from a blank screen or the previous tab's output and\n   * cursor stay on it.\n   * @param tabId - the tab about to be bound.\n   */\n  const needsScreenClear = (tabId: string): boolean => {\n    const rendered = renderedRef.current\n    return rendered !== undefined && rendered !== tabId\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Draw a retained screen the host cannot replay (adopted output, or a tab\n   * whose session is gone) and mark the terminal as this tab's.\n   * @param term - the single terminal.\n   * @param tabId - the tab that owns the text.\n   * @param retained - the text to draw; empty leaves a blank screen.\n   */\n  const drawRetained = (term: Terminal, tabId: string, retained: string): void => {\n    if (needsScreenClear(tabId)) term.reset()\n    if (retained !== '') term.write(retained)\n    renderedRef.current = tabId\n  }\n\n  /** Bind one connection's frames onto the single terminal. */\n  const bindConnection = (tab: TerminalTabRecord, connection: TerminalConnection): void => {\n    const view = ensureTerm()\n    if (view === undefined) return\n    linkRef.current = { tabId: tab.id, connection }\n    renderedRef.current = tab.id\n    view.term.options.disableStdin = false\n    connection.onReady = (sessionId) => {\n      controller.clearTerminalAuthPrompt(tab.id)\n      controller.readyTerminalTab(tab.id, sessionId)\n    }\n    connection.onOutput = (data) => {\n      view.term.write(data)\n      controller.appendTerminalOutput(tab.id, data)\n    }\n    connection.onAuthPrompt = (name, instructions, prompts) => {\n      // The challenge and the answer being typed live on the tab record: a\n      // prompt for another tab must not touch the field on screen, and two\n      // challenges must never share one draft.\n      controller.setTerminalAuthPrompt(tab.id, { name, instructions, prompts })\n    }\n    connection.onExit = (_code, error) => {\n      const bound = linkRef.current\n      const wasBound = bound !== null && bound.connection === connection\n      if (wasBound) linkRef.current = null\n      connection.onReady = undefined\n      connection.onOutput = undefined\n      connection.onAuthPrompt = undefined\n      connection.onExit = undefined\n      view.term.options.disableStdin = true\n      if (!wasBound) return\n      // The tab keeps its screen and its place; draw it before the live frames\n        // resume rather than showing a gap.\n        drawRetained(view.term, tab.id, controller.readTerminalOutput(tab.id))\n        bindConnection(tab, adopted)\n        return\n      }\n    }\n    if (tab.status === 'connecting') {\n      // A tab that opens a socket starts from a blank screen: without this the\n      // previous tab's output stays on the one terminal until the host speaks.\n      drawRetained(view.term, tab.id, '')\n      controller.clearTerminalOutput(tab.id)\n      bindConnection(tab, api.openTerminal(tab.alias, view.term.cols, view.term.rows))\n      return\n    }\n    if (tab.status === 'connected' && tab.sessionId !== undefined) {\n      const sessionId = tab.sessionId\n      if (needsScreenClear(tab.id)) {\n        // The host replays its scrollback on attach, so the screen starts empty\n        // and the retained copy is replaced by that replay.\n        view.term.reset()\n        controller.clearTerminalOutput(tab.id)\n        renderedRef.current = tab.id\n      }\n      bindConnection(tab, api.attachTerminal(sessionId, view.term.cols, view.term.rows))\n      return\n    }\n    // exited / error: no live session to attach to.  </button>\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  className={css.termTabClose}\n                  aria-label={tt('terminal.closeTab')}\n                  title={tt('terminal.closeTab')}\n                  onClick={() => { closeTab(tab.id) }}\n                >\n                  <span aria-hidden=\"true\">{'\\u00d7'}</span>\n                </button>\n title={tt('terminal.newTab')}\n            disabled={draftAlias === ''}\n            onClick={connect}\n          >\n            <span aria-hidden=\"true\">+</span>\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      )}\n      <div className={css.controls}>\n        <select className={css.input} value={draftAlias} onChange={event => { controller.setDraftAlias(event.target.value) }}>\n       "content": "/**\n * SSH panel controller: the single owner of the panel's view state.\n *\n * Framework-free (structural runtime faces, task-board core/controller.ts\n * style) so the sidebar row and the React panel share one tiny subscription\n * surface. The state lives only for the browser session (no persistence).\n *\n * The active tab, the hosts-tab connect request, the terminal tabs and their\n * host session ids live here rather than inside the panel components: the\n * layout mounts a keyed page only while its panel is selected, so\n * component-local state would reset the tab on every panel switch and lose\n * the ids a reattach needs.\n *\n * Terminal tabs (issue #1950) are records, not sockets. One tab is the tab\n * shown in the single xterm; a tab that is not shown either owns a detached\n * host session (reattached by id, which replays the host scrollback) or no\n * session at all. The controller is also the place where a still-connecting\n * socket is adopted when a view goes away: a connection that has not reported\n * its session id yet cannot be detached, so dropping it would leave the host\n * PTY with no owner (the orphan the reference implementation produced).\n */\n\nimport type { TerminalConnection } from '../api.ts'\n\n/** The panel's tab identifiers. */\nexport type SshTab = 'hosts' | 'terminal' | 'transfer' | 'tunnels' | 'cluster'\n\n/** Stable id shared by the sidebar panel row and the main-slot page. */\nexport const SSH_PANEL_ID = 'ssh'\n\n/** Lifecycle of one terminal tab. */\nexport type TerminalTabStatus =\n  /** Socket open, the host has not reported a session id yet. */\n  | 'connecting'\n  /** The host reported a session id; the shell is live. */\n  | 'connected'\n  /** The remote shell ended. The tab keeps its screen; the session id is cleared. */\n  | 'exited'\n  /** The connection failed. The tab keeps the reason; the session id is cleared. */\n  | 'error'\n\n/** A keyboard-interactive challenge waiting for this tab's answer. */\nexport interface TerminalAuthPrompt {\n  name: string\n  instructions: string\n  prompts: Array<{ prompt: string; echo: boolean }>\n}\n\n/** One terminal tab, independent of the socket that currently serves it. */\nexport interface TerminalTabRecord {\n  /** Local tab id, stable across panel switches (never the host session id). */\n  id: string\n  /** Host alias this tab opened. Several tabs may share one alias. */\n  alias: string\n  status: TerminalTabStatus\n  /** Host-side PTY session id, present only while the shell is live. */\n  sessionId?: string\n  /** Exit or failure text for the `exited` / `error` states. */\n  detail?: string\n  /** Code of a close that never reached the host; the tab is kept. */\n  closeError?: string\n  /** Challenge captured for this tab, whoever was on screen when it arrived. */\n  authPrompt?: TerminalAuthPrompt\n  /**\n   * The answer being typed for {@link TerminalTabRecord.authPrompt}, owned by\n   * this tab: one shared draft let a challenge on tab B inherit (and submit)\n   * the characters typed for tab A.\n   */\n  authAnswers?: string[]\n}\n\n/** The terminal fields a later step may change on one tab. */\nexport type TerminalTabPatch = Omit<TerminalTabRecord, 'id' | 'alias'>\n\n/** What to do with an adopted connection once the host reports its session. */\nexport type TerminalLinkIntent = 'detach' | 'close'\n\n/** Immutable controller snapshot for UI subscriptions. */\nexport interface PanelControllerSnapshot {\n  /** Whether the center column shows this panel. */\n  panelOpen: boolean\n  /** The tab the panel is showing. */\n  activeTab: SshTab\n  /** Every terminal tab, in strip order. */\n  terminalTabs: readonly TerminalTabRecord[]\n  /** The tab the single xterm is bound to, or undefined when there is none. */\n  activeTerminalTabId: string | undefined\n  /** Host picked in the terminal toolbar; the next tab opens on it. */\n  draftAlias: string\n}\n\n/**\n * The layout's panel-navigation face: selecting the panel is the layout's\n * business, and this is the one call that asks for it (null returns the column\n * to the conversation). Optional, so a shell-less composition keeps the pure\n * state transitions testable.\n */\nexport interface PanelNavigationFace {\n  /** Select this panel, or null to hand the column back to the conversation. */\n  select(panelId: string | null): void\n}\n\n/** Controller dependencies. */\nexport interface PanelControllerDeps {\n  /** Layout panel selection; absent keeps the controller state-only. */\n  panel?: PanelNavigationFace\n}\n\n/** Byte cap for the retained screen of one tab (the host buffers 256 KiB too). */\nconst MAX_RETAINED_BYTES = 256 * 1024\n\n/**\n * UTF-8 byte length of one chunk, without node's Buffer (this half is bundled\n * for the browser). Surrogate pairs count as the four bytes they encode to.\n * @param text - the output chunk.\n * @returns its UTF-8 byte length.\n */\nfunction utf8Bytes(text: string): number {\n  let bytes = 0\n  for (const char of text) {\n    const code = char.codePointAt(0) ?? 0\n    bytes += code < 0x80 ? 1 : code < 0x800 ? 2 : code < 0x10000 ? 3 : 4\n  }\n  return bytes\n}\n\n/** The panel state owner the sidebar row and the view both read. */\nexport class PanelController {\n  private panelOpen = false\n  private activeTab: SshTab = 'hosts'\n  private terminalTabs: readonly TerminalTabRecord[] = []\n  private activeTerminalTabId: string | undefined\n  private draftAlias = ''\n  private nextTerminalTabSeq = 0\n  private listeners = new Set<() => void>()\n  /**\n   * Last screen of each tab, kept outside the snapshot: terminal output must\n   * not re-render the panel on every chunk, and only the terminal view reads\n   * this (when a tab has no session left to replay from).\n   */\n  private readonly retainedScreens = new Map<string, { chunks: string[]; bytes: number }>()\n  /**\n   * Sockets that outlived their view while still connecting. Their session id\n   * is unknown, so they cannot be detached yet; keeping them here is what\n   * prevents a host PTY with no owner.\n   */\n  private readonly adoptedLinks = new Map<string, { connection: TerminalConnection; intent: TerminalLinkIntent }>()\n  /** Cached so getSnapshot is referentially stable between changes. */\n  private snapshot: PanelControllerSnapshot = {\n    panelOpen: false,\n    activeTab: 'hosts',\n    terminalTabs: [],\n    activeTerminalTabId: undefined,\n    draftAlias: '',\n  }\n\n  constructor(private readonly deps: PanelControllerDeps = {}) {}\n\n  getSnapshot(): PanelControllerSnapshot {\n    return this.snapshot\n  }\n\n  subscribe(fn: () => void): () => void {\n    this.listeners.add(fn)\n    return () => { this.listeners.delete(fn) }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Show the panel. The layout owns which panel the column renders, so the\n   * state flip and the selection travel together; the selection is requested\n   * after the snapshot flips, so a subscriber never observes \"open\" while the\n   * shell still shows the conversation.\n   */\n  open(): void {\n    if (this.panelOpen) return\n    this.panelOpen = true\n    this.commit()\n    this.selectPanel(SSH_PANEL_ID)\n  }\n\n  /** Return the column to the conversation, asking the layout explicitly. */\n  close(): void {\n    if (!this.panelOpen) return\n    this.panelOpen = false\n    this.commit()\n    this.selectPanel(null)\n  }\n\n  toggle(): void {\n    if (this.panelOpen) this.close()\n    else this.open()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Reflect a selection made outside this controller (the user clicked another\n   * sidebar row, or the layout dropped the panel id).\n   * @param panelId - the layout's current panel id, or null for the conversation.\n   */\n  syncPanelSelection(panelId: string | null): void {\n    const open = panelId === SSH_PANEL_ID\n    if (open === this.panelOpen) return\n    this.panelOpen = open\n    this.commit()\n  }\n\n  /** Switch tabs, keeping every other piece of view state. */\n  setActiveTab(tab: SshTab): void {\n    if (this.activeTab === tab) return\n    this.activeTab = tab\n    this.commit()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Hand the terminal tab a host to connect to (the hosts-tab \"connect\"\n   * action): the tab exists before the view does, so a panel switch during the\n   * handshake still shows the connecting tab and adopts its socket.\n   * @param alias - the configured host alias.\n   */\n  requestConnect(alias: string): void {\n    this.activeTab = 'terminal'\n    this.openTerminalTab(alias)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Add a terminal tab on the alias and make it the shown one. Several tabs\n   * may target one alias on purpose: each owns its own host PTY.\n   * @param alias - the configured host alias.\n   * @returns the new tab id.\n   */\n  openTerminalTab(alias: string): string {\n    this.nextTerminalTabSeq += 1\n    const id = 'tab-' + String(this.nextTerminalTabSeq)\n    this.terminalTabs = [...this.terminalTabs, { id, alias, status: 'connecting' }]\n    this.activeTerminalTabId = id\n    this.draftAlias = alias\n    this.retainedScreens.delete(id)\n    this.commit()\n    return id\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Show an existing tab and make the toolbar follow its host, so a new tab\n   * opens on the host the user is looking at.\n   * @param id - the tab id.\n   */\n  setActiveTerminalTab(id: string): void {\n    if (this.activeTerminalTabId === id) return\n    const tab = this.terminalTab(id)\n    if (tab === undefined) return\n    this.activeTerminalTabId = id\n    this.draftAlias = tab.alias\n    this.commit()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Remove one tab and forget its screen. When the shown tab closes, the\n   * neighbours decide what the xterm shows next: the tab that took its place,\n   * else the one before it, else nothing.\n   * @param id - the tab id.\n   */\n  closeTerminalTab(id: string): void {\n    const index = this.terminalTabs.findIndex(tab => tab.id === id)\n    this.retainedScreens.delete(id)\n    // A still-connecting socket was adopted, not detached, and the tab is going\n    // away: its session must end rather than be left without an owner. The\n    // intent is retargeted in the live entry instead of being forgotten, because\n    // forgetting it leaves the old detach handler in charge of the ready frame.\n    const adopted = this.adoptedLinks.get(id)\n    if (adopted !== undefined) adopted.intent = 'close'\n    if (index < 0) return\n    const wasActive = this.activeTerminalTabId === id\n    this.terminalTabs = this.terminalTabs.filter(tab => tab.id !== id)\n    if (wasActive) {\n      const neighbour = this.terminalTabs[index] ?? this.terminalTabs[index - 1]\n      this.activeTerminalTabId = neighbour?.id\n      if (neighbour !== undefined) this.draftAlias = neighbour.alias\n    }\n    this.commit()\n  }\n\n  /** The tab record with this id, or undefined when it no longer exists. */\n  terminalTab(id: string): TerminalTabRecord | undefined {\n    return this.terminalTabs.find(tab => tab.id === id)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Apply a partial update to one tab; a tab that was closed in the meantime\n   * is left alone rather than resurrected.\n   * @param id - the tab id.\n   * @param patch - the fields to change.\n   */\n  patchTerminalTab(id: string, patch: Partial<TerminalTabPatch>): void {\n    let found = false\n    const next = this.terminalTabs.map(tab => {\n      if (tab.id !== id) return tab\n      found = true\n      return { ...tab, ...patch }\n    })\n    if (!found) return\n    this.terminalTabs = next\n    this.commit()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Record the host session of a ready tab and clear the challenge it carried.\n   * @param id - the tab id.\n   * @param sessionId - the id the host reported on its ready frame.\n   */\n  readyTerminalTab(id: string, sessionId: string): void {\n    this.patchTerminalTab(id, {\n      status: 'connected',\n      sessionId,\n      detail: undefined,\n      closeError: undefined,\n      authPrompt: undefined,\n      authAnswers: undefined,\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The remote shell ended: the tab keeps its screen and its place, and the\n   * dead session id is dropped so nothing tries to reattach to it.\n   * @param id - the tab id.\n   * @param detail - why it ended, when the transport said.\n   */\n  exitTerminalTab(id: string, detail?: string): void {\n    // The close failure belonged to a session that no longer exists: keeping it\n    // would leave a tab that keeps reporting a close it already got.\n    this.patchTerminalTab(id, {\n      status: 'exited',\n      sessionId: undefined,\n      detail,\n      authPrompt: undefined,\n      authAnswers: undefined,\n      closeError: undefined,\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The connection failed. The tab stays with the reason so the user can read\n   * it and close the tab themselves.\n   * @param id - the tab id.\n   * @param detail - the failure text.\n   */\n  failTerminalTab(id: string, detail: string): void {\n    this.patchTerminalTab(id, {\n      status: 'error',\n      sessionId: undefined,\n      detail,\n      authPrompt: undefined,\n      authAnswers: undefined,\n      closeError: undefined,\n    })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * A background close never reached the host. The tab keeps its live session\n   * id (so a retry can still end it) and says so instead of vanishing.\n   * @param id - the tab id.\n   * @param reason - the reason code shown by the view.\n   */\n  markTerminalCloseFailed(id: string, reason: string): void {\n    this.patchTerminalTab(id, { closeError: reason })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Store the keyboard-interactive challenge this tab has to answer, with a\n   * blank answer of this challenge's own length. A prompt on another tab never\n   * touches this record, which is what keeps two challenges from sharing input.\n   * @param id - the tab id.\n   * @param prompt - the challenge the host asked for.\n   */\n  setTerminalAuthPrompt(id: string, prompt: TerminalAuthPrompt): void {\n    this.patchTerminalTab(id, { authPrompt: prompt, authAnswers: prompt.prompts.map(() => '') })\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Record one character typed for this tab's challenge.\n   * @param id - the tab id.\n   * @param index - which prompt of the challenge.\n   * @param value - the field's current text.\n   */\n  setTerminalAuthAnswer(id: string, index: number, value: string): void {\n    const tab = this.terminalTab(id)\n    if (tab === undefined || tab.authPrompt === undefined) return\n    const answers = [...(tab.authAnswers ?? tab.authPrompt.prompts.map(() => ''))]\n    answers[index] = value\n    this.patchTerminalTab(id, { authAnswers: answers })\n  }\n\n  /** Drop the challenge once it was answered, cancelled, or could not apply. */\n  clearTerminalAuthPrompt(id: string): void {\n    if (this.terminalTab(id)?.authPrompt === undefined) return\n    this.patchTerminalTab(id, { authPrompt: undefined, authAnswers: undefined })\n  }\n\n  /** Choose the alias the next terminal tab opens on. */\n  setDraftAlias(alias: string): void {\n    if (this.draftAlias === alias) return\n    this.draftAlias = alias\n    this.commit()\n  }\n\n  /** Append one output chunk to the retained screen of a tab. */\n  appendTerminalOutput(id: string, chunk: string): void {\n    const screen = this.retainedScreens.get(id) ?? { chunks: [], bytes: 0 }\n    screen.chunks.push(chunk)\n    screen.bytes += utf8Bytes(chunk)\n    while (screen.bytes > MAX_RETAINED_BYTES && screen.chunks.length > 1) {\n      const dropped = screen.chunks.shift() ?? ''\n      screen.bytes -= utf8Bytes(dropped)\n    }\n    this.retainedScreens.set(id, screen)\n  }\n\n  /** The retained screen of a tab, concatenated for a redraw. */\n  readTerminalOutput(id: string): string {\n    return (this.retainedScreens.get(id)?.chunks ?? []).join('')\n  }\n\n  /** Forget the retained screen (a fresh replay from the host replaces it). */\n  clearTerminalOutput(id: string): void {\n    this.retainedScreens.delete(id)\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Keep a still-connecting socket alive after its view went away. The socket\n   * cannot be detached yet (no session id), so the intent is applied when the\n   * host reports it: `detach` leaves the shell for a later reattach, `close`\n   * ends the session of a tab the user closed.\n   * @param tabId - the tab the socket belongs to.\n   * @param connection - the live connection.\n   * @param intent - what to do once the session id arrives.\n   */\n  adoptTerminalLink(tabId: string, connection: TerminalConnection, intent: TerminalLinkIntent): void {\n    const entry = { connection, intent }\n    this.adoptedLinks.set(tabId, entry)\n    // Output that arrives while no view is bound still belongs to the tab, so it\n    // goes into the retained screen: reclaiming the socket then replays the\n    // whole adopt window instead of showing a gap. A tab that was closed in the\n    // meantime stays closed — appending would recreate its retained entry and\n    // hand a deleted tab a screen again.\n    connection.onOutput = (data) => {\n      if (this.terminalTab(tabId) === undefined) return\n      this.appendTerminalOutput(tabId, data)\n    }\n    connection.onAuthPrompt = (name, instructions, prompts) => {\n      if (this.terminalTab(tabId) === undefined) return\n      this.setTerminalAuthPrompt(tabId, { name, instructions, prompts })\n    }\n    connection.onReady = (sessionId) => {\n      // The intent is read now, not when the socket was adopted: closing the tab\n      // while it connects retargets the entry to `close`, and a detach here\n      // would leave a host PTY nobody owns.\n      const decided = this.adoptedLinks.get(tabId)?.intent ?? entry.intent\n      this.adoptedLinks.delete(tabId)\n      this.readyTerminalTab(tabId, sessionId)\n      if (decided === 'close') connection.close()\n      else connection.detach()\n    }\n    connection.onExit = (_code, error) => {\n      this.adoptedLinks.delete(tabId)\n      this.failTerminalTab(tabId, error ?? 'connection closed')\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Take an adopted socket back when its tab is shown again, so the host never\n   * opens a second PTY for the same tab.\n   * @param tabId - the tab id.\n   * @returns the connection, or undefined when nothing was adopted.\n   */\n  reclaimTerminalLink(tabId: string): TerminalConnection | undefined {\n    const adopted = this.adoptedLinks.get(tabId)\n    if (adopted === undefined) return undefined\n    // A close intent is already on its way out; leave it to finish.\n    if (adopted.intent === 'close') return undefined\n    this.adoptedLinks.delete(tabId)\n    adopted.connection.onReady = undefined\n    adopted.connection.onExit = undefined\n    adopted.connection.onAuthPrompt = undefined\n    // onOutput stays: the view replaces it when it binds, and keeping it until\n    // then means no chunk is lost between reclaim and bind.\n    return adopted.connection\n  }\n\n  private commit(): void {\n    this.snapshot = {\n      panelOpen: this.panelOpen,\n      activeTab: this.activeTab,\n      terminalTabs: this.terminalTabs,\n      activeTerminalTabId: this.activeTerminalTabId,\n      draftAlias: this.draftAlias,\n    }\n    for (const fn of [...this.listeners]) fn()\n  }\n\n  /** Ask the layout to select a panel; a shell without the face is a no-op. */\n  private selectPanel(panelId: string | null): void {\n    try {\n      this.deps.panel?.select(panelId)\n    } catch {\n      // The layout service throws by contract before its root entry mounts;\n      // the state flip above already stands and the next selection retries.\n    }\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "// Generated by scripts/sync-shared.mjs from shared/client/telemetry.ts. Do not edit this copy; edit the shared source and run \"node scripts/sync-shared.mjs\".\n/**\n * Anonymous install telemetry shared by the DSH Web UI family plugins.\n *\n * Once per UTC day per browser, each wired plugin sends one heartbeat to\n * the dsh-market edge API listing its package name (and version when known).\n * The payload carries no conversation data and no identifiers beyond a random\n * UUID generated in localStorage; the server hashes it with a deployment salt\n * before storage and never persists IP addresses. Sends are fire-and-forget:\n * failures stay silent and simply retry on a later mount or day.       "content": "/**\n * SFTP transfers: upload (file or recursive tree), single-file download, and\n * remote directory listing. Every channel is opened once per operation and\n * released exactly once so sshd's MaxSessions cap is never exhausted.\n */\n\nimport { existsSync, lstatSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { dirname, join, relative, resolve as resolvePath } from 'node:path'\nimport { Client, type SFTPWrapper } from 'ssh2'\nimport type { RemoteDirEntry, TransferProgress } from '../protocol.ts'\nimport { withClient, type PoolEngine } from './connection-pool.ts'\n\n/** Walk a local directory, collecting relative paths of every file. */\nexport function walkLocalDir(root: string): string[] {\n  const files: string[] = []\n  const visit = (dir: string): void => {\n    for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) {\n      const full = join(dir, name)\n      // lstat, not stat: a symlink must never be followed — a link cycle\n      // (ln -s . self) recurses forever under stat, and a link to a file\n      // would silently upload the target's bytes.\n      const stat = lstatSync(full)\n      if (stat.isSymbolicLink()) continue\n      if (stat.isDirectory()) visit(full)\n      else if (stat.isFile()) files.push(relative(root, full).replaceAll('\\\\', '/'))\n    }\n  }\n  visit(root)\n  return files\n}\n\n/** Upload one local file (or directory tree) to a remote path. */\nexport async function upload(\n  engine: PoolEngine,\n  alias: string,\n  localPath: string,\n  remotePath: string,\n  recursive: boolean,\n  onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void,\n): Promise<{ bytes: number; files: number }> {\n  // Remote paths must be absolute: the mkdir chain and fastPut must agree\n  // on one resolution (relative paths previously created dirs at the root).\n  if (!remotePath.startsWith('/')) {\n    throw new Error('remotePath must be an absolute path (got \\'' + remotePath + '\\')')\n  }\n  const local = resolvePath(localPath)\n  if (!existsSync(local)) throw new Error('local path not found: \\'' + localPath + '\\'')\n  return withClient(engine, alias, (client) => withSftp(client, async (sftp) => {\n    const stat = statSync(local)\n    let files: string[]\n    if (stat.isDirectory()) {\n      if (!recursive) throw new Error('\\'' + localPath + '\\' is a directory — enable recursive upload')\n      files = walkLocalDir(local)\n      await ensureRemoteDir(sftp, remotePath)\n    } else {\n      files = ['']\n      await ensureRemoteDir(sftp, dirname(remotePath))\n    }\n    let bytes = 0\n    for (const rel of files) {\n      const src = rel === '' ? local : join(local, rel)\n      // Remote paths always use forward slashes; normalize any OS separators.\n      const remoteRel = rel.split(/[\\\\/]/).join('/')\n      const dst = rel === '' ? remotePath : remotePath.replace(/\\/$/, '') + '/' + remoteRel\n      await fastPut(sftp, src, dst, engine.opts.sftpConcurrency, onProgress)\n      bytes += statSync(src).size\n    }\n    return { bytes, files: files.length }\n  }))\n}\n\n/** Download one remote file to a local path. */\nexport async function download(\n  engine: PoolEngine,\n  alias: string,\n  remotePath: string,\n  localPath: string,\n  onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void,\n): Promise<{ bytes: number }> {\n  return withClient(engine, alias, (client) => withSftp(client, async (sftp) => {\n    const stat = await new Promise<{ isDirectory: () => boolean }>((resolve, reject) => {\n      sftp.stat(remotePath, (error, stats) => error !== undefined ? reject(error) : resolve(stats))\n    })\n    if (stat.isDirectory()) {\n      throw new Error('\\'' + remotePath + '\\' is a directory — directory download is not supported yet (download individual files)')\n    }\n    const local = resolvePath(localPath)\n    if (!existsSync(dirname(local))) mkdirSync(dirname(local), { recursive: true })\n    await fastGet(sftp, remotePath, local, engine.opts.sftpConcurrency, onProgress)\n    return { bytes: statSync(local).size }\n  }))\n}\n\n/** List a remote directory (file browser). */\nexport async function ls(engine: PoolEngine, alias: string, path: string): Promise<RemoteDirEntry[]> {\n  return withClient(engine, alias, (client) => withSftp(client, async (sftp) => {\n    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n      sftp.readdir(path, (error, list) => {\n        if (error !== undefined) {\n          reject(error)\n          return\n        }\n        const entries: RemoteDirEntry[] = list.map(item => ({\n          name: item.filename,\n          type: item.attrs.isDirectory() ? 'dir' : item.attrs.isFile() ? 'file' : 'other',\n          size: item.attrs.size,\n          mtimeMs: item.attrs.mtime * 1000,\n          mode: item.attrs.mode,\n        }))\n        resolve(entries)\n      })\n    })\n  }))\n}\n\n/**\n * Open one SFTP channel, run the operation, and release the channel exactly\n * once when the operation settles (success or error). ssh2 keeps each\n * subsystem channel open until end(); without this, every transfer leaks a\n * channel until sshd's MaxSessions cap makes all later opens fail.\n */\nasync function withSftp<T>(client: Client, run: (sftp: SFTPWrapper) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {\n  const sftp = await sftpChannel(client)\n  let ended = false\n  const endOnce = (): void => {\n    if (ended) return\n    ended = true\n    try { sftp.end() } catch { /* channel already closed */ }\n  }\n  // The channel can also close underneath us (peer reset, timeout); the\n  // guard makes the finally below a no-op instead of ending it twice.\n  sftp.once('close', endOnce)\n  try {\n    return await run(sftp)\n  } finally {\n    endOnce()\n  }\n}\n\nfunction sftpChannel(client: Client): Promise<SFTPWrapper> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    client.sftp((error, sftp) => error !== undefined ? reject(error) : resolve(sftp))\n  })\n}\n\n/** Create a remote directory chain (stat-then-mkdir per segment). */\nfunction ensureRemoteDir(sftp: SFTPWrapper, remote: string): Promise<void> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const segments = remote.replace(/^\\/+/, '').split('/').filter(segment => segment !== '')\n    const walk = (index: number): void => {\n      if (index >= segments.length) {\n        resolve()\n        return\n      }\n      const current = '/' + segments.slice(0, index + 1).join('/')\n      sftp.stat(current, (statError) => {\n        if (statError === undefined) {\n          walk(index + 1)\n          return\n        }\n        // Statting a missing path fails; mkdir it (idempotent because the\n        // stat check runs first — some sftp servers throw on EEXIST).\n        sftp.mkdir(current, (mkdirError) => {\n          if (mkdirError !== undefined) {\n            reject(mkdirError)\n            return\n          }\n          walk(index + 1)\n        })\n      })\n    }\n    walk(0)\n  })\n}\n\n/** One fastPut/fastGet transfer with throttled progress (the two directions share everything but the verb). */\nfunction fastTransfer(sftp: SFTPWrapper, kind: 'put' | 'get', src: string, dst: string, concurrency: number, onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void): Promise<void> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    // Progress frames name the destination on upload, the source on download;\n    // the final size comes from the local side of the transfer.\n    const file = kind === 'put' ? dst : src\n    const finalSize = (): number => statSync(kind === 'put' ? src : dst).size\n    let last = 0\n    let lastEmit = 0\n    const started = Date.now()\n    if (kind === 'put') {\n      onProgress?.({ phase: 'transferring', file, transferred: 0, total: statSync(src).size, percent: 0 })\n    }\n    const step = (transferred: number, _chunk: number, total: number): void => {\n      const now = Date.now()\n      // Throttle: high-speed links fire one callback per chunk; the UI only\n      // needs ~10 frames per second.\n      if (now - lastEmit < 100 && transferred < total) return\n      lastEmit = now\n      const elapsed = (now - started) / 1000\n      onProgress?.({\n        phase: 'transferring',\n        file,\n        transferred,\n        total,\n        percent: total > 0 ? Math.round((transferred / total) * 1000) / 10 : 0,\n        speedBps: elapsed > 0 ? Math.round((transferred - last) / elapsed) : undefined,\n      })\n      last = transferred\n    }\n    const done = (error: unknown): void => {\n      if (error !== undefined) {\n        onProgress?.({ phase: 'error', file, transferred: 0, total: 0, percent: 0, error: String(error) })\n        reject(error)\n      } else {\n        onProgress?.({ phase: 'done', file, transferred: finalSize(), total: finalSize(), percent: 100 })\n        resolve()\n      }\n    }\n    if (kind === 'put') sftp.fastPut(src, dst, { concurrency, step }, done)\n    else sftp.fastGet(src, dst, { concurrency, step }, done)\n  })\n}\n\nfunction fastPut(sftp: SFTPWrapper, src: string, dst: string, concurrency: number, onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void): Promise<void> {\n  return fastTransfer(sftp, 'put', src, dst, concurrency, onProgress)\n}\n\nfunction fastGet(sftp: SFTPWrapper, src: string, dst: string, concurrency: number, onProgress?: (progress: TransferProgress) => void): Promise<void> {\n  return fastTransfer(sftp, 'get', src, dst, concurrency, onProgress)\n}"
